description: The only CLI for the modern Agilix Dawn API — render a course's full structure, export curriculum and rosters, and mirror your catalog offline.

tools.name: concept_get
tools.description: Get one concept (course) by id, including full section/instruction structure. Required: id. Returns the Concept.

tools.name: concept_list
tools.description: List catalog concepts (courses/content). Uses the Dawn search DSL. Optional: search (default: {'limit':100}), order-featured. Returns array of Concept.

params.name: search
params.description: Dawn search DSL as JSON: {query,start,limit,sort,join,include}. query is Lucene (e.g. title:driver, status:enabled).

tools.name: config_get
tools.description: Show the tenant's public configuration (name, root org, version, auth providers, payment). Returns the Config.

tools.name: conversation_list
tools.description: List conversations. Uses the Dawn search DSL. Optional: search (default: {'limit':100}). Returns array of Conversation.

tools.name: organization_list
tools.description: List organizations. Uses the Dawn search DSL. Optional: search (default: {'limit':100}). Returns array of Organization.

tools.name: progress_list
tools.description: List learner progress. Uses the Dawn search DSL (e.g. query:'user:u_... AND NOT state:preview'). Optional: search (default: {'limit':100}). Returns array of Progress.

tools.name: purchase_list
tools.description: List purchases. Uses the Dawn search DSL. Optional: search (default: {'limit':100}). Returns array of Purchase.

tools.name: user_list
tools.description: List/search users. Uses the Dawn search DSL. Optional: search (default: {'limit':100}). Returns array of User.

tools.name: user_me
tools.description: Show the authenticated user (whoami). Returns the User.
